```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

# Uploading Data
## from https://fed.dcceew.gov.au/datasets/erin::collaborative-australian-protected-areas-database-capad-2024-marine/about

```{r}
mpa <- read_sf("MPA_Status_Shapefile/Collaborative_Australian_Protected_Areas_Database_(CAPAD)_2024_-_Marine.shp")
```

### using only VIC and TAS data
```{r}
mpa <- mpa |>
  filter(STATE %in% c("TAS", "VIC", "COM"))
```


###checking on coordinate systems

```{r}
#st_crs(mpa) #checking what the current coordinate system of the file is

mpa <- st_transform(mpa, 4326)
#turning off S2 because it prevents me from cleaning my geometries (I want to use GCOS to clean geometries not S2)
#S2 = spherical geometry
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
#making my geometries good
mpa <- st_make_valid(mpa)
#redrawing my geometries so i won't get errors/double verticies or overlapping lines later
mpa <- st_buffer(mpa, 0)
#turning S2 back on
sf_use_s2(TRUE)
```
```{r}
bad <- which(!st_is_valid(mpa))
bad
```

```{r}
mpa_clean <- mpa[-c(225, 512, 719, 786, 915, 1040, 1099, 1116, 1639), ]
```

```{r}
bad <- which(!st_is_valid(mpa_clean))
bad
```

```{r}
mpa_clean <- mpa_clean[-c(1072), ]
```

```{r}
bad <- which(!st_is_valid(mpa_clean))
bad
```

```{r}
fishMaster <- read_csv("fishMaster.csv")

fishMaster_sf <- st_as_sf(fishMaster, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
```


```{r}
# rough bounding box around data
combined <- read_csv("combined.csv")
# Convert your data frame to sf points
combined_sf <- st_as_sf(combined, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
#changing location in the dataset just for seeing what datatype it is purposes
combined_sf <- combined_sf |>
  relocate(geometry, .after = mean_chlor_a)
```

```{r}
mpa_mapping <- mpa_clean |>
  filter(STATE %in% c("TAS", "VIC"))

bbox <- st_bbox(combined_sf)

#mapping to see about how many intersects i should expect
aus <- ne_states(country = "australia", returnclass = "sf")

vic_tas <- aus |>  filter(name %in% c("Victoria", "Tasmania"))
#actual map
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = vic_tas, fill = "grey90", color = "grey40") +
  geom_sf(data = mpa_clean, fill = "turquoise", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = fishMaster_sf, color = "red", size = 1) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bbox["ymax"], bbox["ymin"])
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


# Checking Intersects

```{r}
combined_with_mpa <- st_join(fishMaster_sf, mpa_clean, join = st_within)
```

# cleaning this dataset

```{r}
#removing columns from mpa_clean that aren't relevant to me
combined_with_mpa <- combined_with_mpa |>
	select(-c(OBJECTID, PA_ID, PA_PID, NRS_PA, NRS_MPA, GAZ_AREA, GIS_AREA, GAZ_DATE, LATEST_GAZ, STATE, AUTHORITY, DATASOURCE, GOVERNANCE, COMMENTS, ENVIRON, OVERLAP, MGT_PLAN, ZONE_TYPE, EPBC, LONGITUDE, LATITUDE, PA_SYSTEM, Shape__Are, Shape__Len, RES_NUMBER))
```

```{r}
#moving and renaming columns
#combined_with_mpa <- combined_with_mpa |>
 # rename(mpa_name = NAME,
 #        mpa_type = TYPE,
  #       mpa_type_abbreviation = TYPE_ABBR,
 #        iucn_protection_status = IUCN)

combined_with_mpa <- combined_with_mpa |>
  relocate(mpa_name, mpa_type, mpa_type_abbreviation, iucn_protection_status, .after = location)
```

```{r}
combined_with_mpa$iucn_protection_status <- ifelse(
  is.na(combined_with_mpa$iucn_protection_status),
  "unprotected",
  combined_with_mpa$iucn_protection_status
)
```

```{r}
#filtering for year
combined_with_mpa <- combined_with_mpa |>
  filter(year >= 2012, year <= 2023)
```

```{r}
combined_with_mpa <- st_drop_geometry(combined_with_mpa)
```

```{r}
combined_with_mpa <- combined_with_mpa |>
  select(c(survey_id, mpa_name, mpa_type, mpa_type_abbreviation, iucn_protection_status))
```

```{r}
write.csv(combined_with_mpa, "mpaFish.csv")
```

# Preparing this dataframe for combining with the actual dataframe


```{r}
combined_mpa <- combined_with_mpa |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  mutate(
    longitude = st_coordinates(combined_sf)[,1],
    latitude  = st_coordinates(combined_sf)[,2]
  )
```
